description: Gladstone Area Water Board - Reservoirs is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Local Government, Water and Volunteers. This dataset describes the locations of Gladstone Area Water Board (GAWB) owned tank storage reservoir sites within the Gladstone Regional Council and Rockhampton Regional Council Local Government Authority Areas.The dataset contains tank storage reservoirs associated with the bulk water supply of both raw and potable water networks. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Local Government, Water and Volunteers. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, XML. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
